title: Decoupling, exponential sums and the Riemann zeta function
relevant_concepts: decoupling for the parabola applied to van der Corput theory
notes: J. Amer. Math. Soc. 30 (2017), 205-224. Establishes the exponent pair (13/84, 55/84), the current record region of the exponent-pair hull relevant here. For the PS-inversion fluctuation sums T_j = sum_{m<=M} e(c m^{9/4} - j m^{2/3}) of docs/problems/juggler_ps_inversion_barrier.md, an exponent pair (p, q) gives the block bound M^{(5/4)p+q}; this pair yields 95/112 ~ 0.848, far above the sub-density target (5/4)p + q < 2/3 that the rate-free floor-Hardy axis requires. The exponent-pair conjecture point (0, 1/2) would clear the barrier and prove the axis with power savings.
